title: News trading
description: 50 news events for 10 fictional companies arrive one at a time, each with a wire headline and a social-media reaction — buy, hold or sell before the next lands. The companies are fictional on purpose: this is a latency demo, not real trading advice. The correct call is the conventional, textbook-expected direction for that kind of news (earnings beat = buy, product recall = sell), a simplification of real markets stated plainly as one.
